instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: SynergyCloud is a B2B SaaS provider specializing in predictive analytics for supply chain optimization within the manufacturing sector. We offer a modular platform tailored to mid-sized enterprises.
answers.pastInitiatives: We recently launched a major overhaul of our core algorithm and piloted two new integration APIs designed to expand our service offerings into adjacent industry verticals.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is market diversification by developing specialized modules for the Healthcare and Retail sectors. We aim to establish a foothold in at least three new geographic regions over the next three years.
answers.teamSize: The core team consists of 15 highly skilled engineers and product managers who are focused on rapid iteration.

opportunities.title: Vertical Solution Pivot (Healthcare Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Developing a completely new analytics module specifically for healthcare compliance and patient flow management will open up an entirely new, high-value market segment beyond manufacturing. This addresses the core need for diversification.

first_actions: Identify top 5 key pain points in the Healthcare supply chain.
Conduct a feasibility study on regulatory compliance (HIPAA).
Allocate initial seed funding for a dedicated 3-person task force.
execution_plan.success_metric: Acquire 5 paying pilot customers in the Healthcare sector within 9 months.
milestones: Q1: Feasibility report complete and team recruited.
Q3: MVP launched for healthcare vertical.

opportunities.title: Cross-Industry API Expansion (Retail Focus)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing modular architecture, we can rapidly build low-cost integration layers for e-commerce analytics. This offers faster revenue growth and diversification without requiring a full platform rebuild.

first_actions: Automate the development pipeline using CI/CD tools.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase total customer usage by 20% through new integration uptake within 6 months.
milestones: Q2: Launch of first retail API template.
Q4: Achieve $1M in annual recurring revenue from cross-industry integrations.

opportunities.title: Geographic Expansion via Localization
opportunities.rationale: Expanding into the APAC region using existing content translation and minor localization efforts allows for lower-risk market entry compared to launching entirely new product features.

first_actions: Hire a dedicated regional account manager based in Singapore/India.
Complete comprehensive language and legal review of compliance.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 anchor clients in the APAC region by end of Year 2.
milestones: Q1: Regional leadership hired and legal framework established.
Q4: First revenue generated from APAC market.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated 'Diversification Task Force' including representatives from Engineering and Sales.
Conduct deep-dive market research on the top 3 healthcare analytics vendors to refine the Radical Pivot plan.
Implement a mandatory quarterly feedback loop focused solely on new vertical feature validation (Healthcare/Retail).

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on the current core manufacturing customer base.
Limited in-house talent pool specifically skilled in Healthcare regulatory compliance.
Slow decision-making cycle when prioritizing new market feature development.
